articles.summary: In high‑risk industrial settings, safety forms the backbone of every successful operation. It supports productivity, quality, and trust – and without it, the rest quickly unravels. Yet too often, safety is viewed only as a compliance exercise: a series of tick boxes, reports, and audits that satisfy regulators but fail to truly protect workers. For […]
articles.title: Lead with Safety: How Decision-Makers Can Inspire a Culture of Protection, Not Just Compliance
